name: devstandard
description: DevStandard's Codex side: delivers the EXECUTOR role. On these projects the main session is Claude Code (plan/dispatch/review/merge); a Codex session is a worker or advisor - the session hook injects that role in repos carrying a committed .devstandard marker, and reference/harness-codex.md defines the role paths. Not a standalone method: install alongside the Claude Code DevStandard plugin, which carries the full method (core.md).
